description: Standalone workstation assistant: Rust core (SQLite, IPC, policy, contained workers) with an operator CLI and a Tauri desktop client

components.name: ironbark-core
components.description: Daemon, durable store, policy engine, process/network containment

components.name: ironbark-cli
components.description: Operator CLI; every subcommand prints exactly one JSON DTO on stdout

components.name: ironbark-desktop
components.description: Tauri desktop client of the same core; built and installed only with --with-desktop

components.name: namespace-bridge
components.description: Worker namespace runner; shipped as the ironbark-core binary's namespace_bridge subcommand, not a separate file

release_gates.note: A release report binds these gates; a missing or failed required gate blocks the release rather than being reported as passed.
owner_approved_and_outstanding: live provider launch and provider/JEV qualification smokes (H1-H8, W1-W3, J2-J3)
release_gates.artwork_rights: Original Ironbark imagery is approved for local use only; redistribution requires an explicit owner disposition before packaging is distributable.

local_qualification.precondition: a local OpenAI-compatible llama.cpp endpoint on 127.0.0.1:8091 (override with --port); loopback only, no paid route
local_qualification.proves: a real streamed local answer, the effective route byte-identical to the requested one with exactly one request to the pinned endpoint, an abort that ends cancelled rather than succeeded, honest unknown billing, and a typed transport failure with no fallback

local_qualification.precondition: a harness engine reachable with a real model (see the receipt for the exact profile/config used)
local_qualification.proves: a real native harness turn through the core with a diff and check receipts, a denied out-of-scope write with no effect, pause/resume preserving the native session, and a cancel observed only after the process exits
